Government clarifies 'Op Sindoor' bravehearts' homage timing

The Ministry of Defence has stated that homage was paid to the bravehearts of 'Operation Sindoor' at the earliest opportunity. This clarification comes amid claims that the six heroes were honored for the first time. The government asserts that tributes were already rendered to the fallen soldiers.
